ch_edit_default_addr_desc: Inherited when an endpoint does not override its address. Joined as base URL + version prefix + path.

ch_edit_endpoints_hint_single: Single-protocol channels have exactly one endpoint matching the channel kind.
addr_unofficial_desc: Use protocol official address when disabled
addr_full_desc: Use verbatim final URL without joining or validation

keypool_desc: Inherited when an endpoint does not specify its own key. One per line, supports multi-key rotation.
keypool_aria: Upstream key pool, one per line
keypool_count_desc: {count} keys in rotation; unusable if empty and endpoint has no key.

keypool_strategy_sticky_desc: Pin key per client, rotate only on failure
keypool_strategy_random_desc: Pick a random key on every request
ep_transcode_desc: Allow translating inbound requests of other protocols into this endpoint. Native requests always passthrough.
probe_desc: Probed available models from the upstream address. Check desired models to import into this endpoint.

ch_adv_test_model_placeholder: Leave empty for first endpoint model
ch_adv_note_placeholder: Primary line, renew at month end
headers_desc: Sent with all upstream calls. Auth headers (Authorization / x-api-key) are managed by the gateway and cannot be overridden.
override_desc: Common fields are merged into all endpoint bodies; protocol groups apply only when hitting that protocol. JSON value, null deletes the field.
models_subtitle: Derived from enabled channels. Pricing is managed in Settings per million tokens.
models_empty: No channels currently provide models — configure channels first
play_subtitle: Requests run through the full gateway pipeline: routing, transcoding, circuit breaking, and logging.
play_empty_hint: Select a model and send your first message.
play_input_placeholder: Type a message, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line
logs_subtitle: Click any row to expand detailed error and token breakdowns.
logs_export_all_tip: Export NDJSON for current filter (up to 50k rows)
logs_upstream_key_used: Upstream key used for this request (masked)
logs_modal_no_body: Not captured — body snapshot disabled or request was multipart form.
keys_subtitle: Clients access the gateway with these keys. Leave model/tag whitelists empty for no restrictions.
keys_edit_desc: Only governance attributes are changed; key value remains untouched.
keys_new_desc: Key plaintext is shown only once upon creation. Save it immediately.
keys_form_budget_hint: , accumulated by pricing table, 0 for unlimited
keys_created_dialog_desc: This is the only time the full key is shown. It cannot be retrieved after closing.
settings_subtitle: Changes require saving to take effect.

sec_policy_native_first_desc: When off, behaves like new-api. When on, native protocol endpoints always outrank transcoded ones for the same model.
sec_policy_mode_weighted_desc: Random selection weighted by channel weight within the highest priority tier.
sec_policy_mode_round_robin_desc: Rotate channels sequentially within the highest priority tier.
sec_policy_mode_first_desc: Always select the first healthy channel within the highest priority tier.
sec_policy_max_upstream_calls_hint: Total upstream call budget including retries. 0 = unlimited, default 8.
sec_policy_retry_same_channel_desc: — recommended off; a 500 error is unlikely to recover immediately on the same line
sec_policy_empty_retry_desc: Retry on the same channel when upstream returns HTTP 200 without text, reasoning, refusal, or tool calls, and completion time minus TTFB is within the window.
sec_policy_strict_200_desc: Convert HTTP 200 responses containing HTML, plain-text errors, or invalid JSON into HTTP 500 to trigger gateway retries and breaker.
sec_policy_validation_error: Max retries 0–32 (0 = unlimited); Max upstream calls 0–255.
sec_policy_empty_retry_validation_error: Window must be 0–3600 seconds, max retries 0–100.
sec_breaker_desc: Suspends endpoints that fail consecutively until cooldown expires with exponential backoff. Setting threshold to 0 disables the breaker.
sec_limits_desc: Gateway-level circuit breaker for all traffic. Protects upstream balance from runaway agent loops. 0 means unlimited.
sec_limits_tpm_hint: Max tokens per minute. RPM cannot catch few requests with huge contexts.
sec_limits_concurrency_hint: Concurrent in-flight requests (held until stream completes)
sec_limits_ip_rpm_hint: Max requests per minute per IP, 0 = unlimited
sec_notify_desc: Pushes circuit breaker, recovery, and auto-disable events to webhook. Channels with 3 consecutive auth failures are auto-disabled and retested periodically.
sec_notify_secret_configured: Configured (leave empty on save to clear)
sec_notify_secret_placeholder_set: New signature secret; leave empty to clear
sec_notify_secret_saved_msg: Signature secret saved. Webhook payloads will include signature header.
sec_notify_secret_desc: When configured, webhook requests carry an X-Refract-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256).
sec_notify_validation_error: Webhook must start with http(s)://; interval 0–1440 mins.
sec_pricing_desc: Priced per million tokens in your preferred currency. Exact names take priority over prefix wildcards. Request logs freeze cost at write time.
sec_pricing_validation_error: Pattern cannot be empty; prices must be non-negative numbers.
sec_retention_desc: Pruned once at startup and every 24 hours according to this setting.
sec_retention_log_bodies_desc: View full request payloads during troubleshooting. Bodies capped at 64KB, streaming stores aggregated text.
sec_retention_validation_error: Please enter an integer between 1 and 3650.
sec_admin_desc: Default admin username is admin@localhost. When enabled, all admin UI and /api requests require this token. The token is hashed and cannot be retrieved. If lost, restart with refract-server --reset-admin.
sec_admin_cookie_notice: Sessions are managed via secure HttpOnly cookies. The browser never persists plaintext tokens.
sec_backup_desc: Export channels, API keys, and settings as a JSON document to restore on another Refract instance. Contains plaintext channel keys; gateway keys contain only hashes.
sec_backup_replace_warning: Replace import will clear all existing channels and keys permanently. Are you sure you want to replace with "{name}"?
sec_data_desc: SQLite online hot backup (VACUUM INTO). Compact and ready to restore. Contains full request logs unlike config backup.
sec_affinity_desc: Bind clients to specific channels based on API keys, headers, or body fields. Affects route selection only; takes effect immediately.
sec_affinity_preset_api_key_desc: Pin downstream clients to the same upstream channel.
sec_affinity_preset_header_desc: Bind by user/session ID passed in client headers.
sec_affinity_preset_body_desc: Bind by user identifier extracted from request body JSON.
sec_affinity_empty_rules: No rules configured; no affinity bindings will be created.
sec_affinity_rule_name: Rule Name (cache key component, must be unique)
sec_affinity_sources_title: Key Sources (evaluated in order, first match wins)
sec_affinity_skip_retry: Do not fall back on failure (maintain binding)
sec_affinity_switch_on_success: Refresh TTL on successful channel route (recommended)
sec_affinity_keep_disabled: Keep binding when channel is disabled
sec_affinity_validation_error: Invalid affinity rules: name must be unique and non-empty, at least one source per rule, header cannot be empty, body path must start with /, TTL 1–604800.
